why: The briefs catch all three must_catch items. (1) Builder step 3 says to "Also add a `### subtract(a, b)` entry (it is exported but currently undocumented)" next to the clamp entry. (2) Verifier Check 3 gets the exports from math.js at the PR head with Object.keys and prints them. That list would be add, subtract, multiply and clamp. The check exits 1 if any listed function is not named in README.md, and it also requires README.md to say what each one does. A note adds that a build documenting only clamp FAILs because subtract is missing. The test is a substring match, which is weak on its own, but the manual reading of README.md makes up for it. (3) Verifier Check 2 calls clamp with lo greater than hi in four cases. It counts a failure unless `e instanceof RangeError`, and it says a plain Error or a TypeError FAILs.
